title: Thanos vs Darkseid: Marvel vs DC Gods
script: This is Thanos. This is Darkseid. So what's the difference? Most fans think Thanos and Darkseid are copies of each other. They're wrong. Thanos is a warlord titan seeking the Infinity Stones to rebalance resource scarcity in the universe. But Darkseid is a New God ruler of Apokolips seeking the Anti-Life Equation to strip all free will across reality. Thanos seeks universal balance, while Darkseid seeks total mental enslavement. Follow for more.
